title: Sub 25 1000 Invo ToA (Leagues)
summary: Gnomonkey completes a 1000 invocation Tombs of Amascut raid in Leagues in under 25 minutes, using the Berserker and Guardian relics together with a Tumeken's shadow. The run is stream commentary with little narration; the video finishes with a purple (a Tumeken's fang) and discussion of how much faster it could go.

outline.text: Chat discussion of the Fire Cell relic vs Banker's Note and horn damage
Middle of the raid, with a short 30-second loss mentioned at about 8:13
Late-raid rooms and max hit callouts
Finishing the raid sub 24 and chest roll
Fang purple and discussion of record times

claims.text: Gnomonkey finishes a 1000 invocation Tombs of Amascut raid on Leagues in sub 25 minutes; at the end he reacts to a sub 24 time.
The description says Gnomonkey tried earlier to do the sub 25 run with just Mystics, but Baba kept him from completion by hitting over 40 through prayer.
To fix this, Gnomonkey farmed Chambers of Xeric and was spooned an Augury and Ancestral chest and legs, then completed the sub 25 raid.
The chest at the end of the sub 25 raid gave a purple, a Tumeken's fang, the third fang.
Gnomonkey notes the unique chance was 24.5% and jokes it rounds up to a 125% chance.

Gnomonkey says his Akkha was terrible and that the run could easily be faster; he lists 5:55 for Wardens and 5:30 for Akkha, with his best Akkha being around four minutes, and thinks sub 22 is easily possible but sub 20 is pushing it.
Gnomonkey does not know if the run is a record time and assumes Newtype will have a better time than the first one he sent.
The description states Gnomonkey wanted to push the time even lower but lacks time due to Chambers of Xeric QoL and playing around with Inferno Leagues speedruns.

topics.name: Leagues build for Tombs of Amascut

claims.text: Gnomonkey's relic setup for this run, per the description, is Production, Fairy, Banker's, Sorcerer's, Bloodthirsty, Farmer's, Berserker and Guardian.
The regions used were Khand, Desert and Kourend.

Gnomonkey says he has not seen a good argument for the Fire Cell relic and thinks it is not better than Banker's Note; he says everyone he has seen take Fire Cell regrets it, and that Banker's Note is insane early game too.
Gnomonkey says Infinity (armor) is pretty garbage and suggests going straight for Virtus.
